body.name: p^{\mathrm G}
body.def: The selected contingency table formed from the released GEUVADIS gene-set number 50 data with \(X\) equal to binarized SWAP70 expression, \(Y\) equal to binarized SBF2-AS1 expression, \(Z\) equal to rs7124238 allele count, and \(W\) equal to the three coarse population groups.
